oracle_review.state_arrays: Independent Python list updates and weighted integer sum; expected checksums22000/29500/37000/44500, capped at3 accepted rising edges; reset priority and held inputs covered.
oracle_review.timed_counter: Independent elapsed-time arithmetic at100ms trace steps, discrete rising-edge detection, integer event count and latch. Initial state,500ms threshold and edge phase are declared local-contract assumptions, not measurements of the official simulator or PLC.
oracle_review.numeric_diagnostics: Independent declared manual saturation result, hexadecimal decimal-digit packing, byte/word composition and explicit raw-word observations; does not call compiler numeric evaluation for expected answers.
oracle_review.shared_components: SDK and VM are separate implementations of the same intended contract. Normalization, XML parsing/emission and reverse compilation share compiler modules. Their agreement is not independent proof of Schneider interpretation or physical behavior.
oracle_review.memory_controls: Memory-only harness injects M800..802 before begin_scan, modeling external memory writes between scans; official animation-table scheduling/force behavior remains unverified.
oracle_review.scope: Three combined algorithms with bounded traces; no claim of complete instruction coverage, all possible inputs, native lifecycle equivalence or hardware timing.
